//: Input format for scripts/standardize-cohort.ts. Copy to <photos-dir>/manifest.json and edit. One cohort per subject; exactly one photo with role 'before', one or more with role 'after'. relativePath is <folder>/<filename>. weeksAfter is metadata only — it does not affect scoring, so a 2-week and a 12-week follow-up are scored identically against the same baseline.
